chinese: 最近我在为考试做准备
english: Recently I have been preparing for the exams.
soundmark: /ˈriːsəntli aɪ hæv bɪn prɪˈperɪŋ fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæmz/

chinese: 有时候我感到压力很大
english: Sometimes I feel under great pressure.

chinese: 制定计划能帮助我节省时间
english: Making a plan helps me save time.
soundmark: /ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə plæn helps mi seɪv taɪm/

chinese: 当我遇到困难时我会向老师求助
english: I ask my teacher for help when I have trouble.
soundmark: /aɪ æsk maɪ ˈtiːtʃər fɔːr help wen aɪ hæv ˈtrʌbəl/

english: I will keep going until the end.
soundmark: /aɪ wɪl kiːp ˈɡoʊɪŋ ənˈtɪl ði end/
